fnol_text: My name is Noor Brennan and I live at 715 Willow Drive, Riverton, WY 82541. You can reach me on (555) 549-8824 or noor.brennan@example.com. On 30 August 2025 the Calder River overtopped near our house after a week of storms. River water flooded the downstairs rooms and the garage. Policy HH-2025-00116. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Brennan on (555) 549-8824 to acknowledge the claim. Noor confirmed the loss date as 30 August 2025.
Site visit to 715 Willow Drive. Neighbour Hiroshi Castillo was present and confirmed the timeline.
Noor sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
